issue.title: Amendment voting drops validators that rotate their signing key from votes and threshold (Version: 3.4.1)
issue.claim_scope: The reporter describes one or more long-running proposing validators; do not generalize to every XRPL validator.

reported_mechanism.root_cause: TrustedVotes::recordedVotes_ is keyed by ephemeral signing PublicKey. Amendment vote lookup uses the signer public key. The trustChanged refresh is called only when trusted master-key membership changes; an ephemeral signing-key rotation with the same master key may not trigger re-keying.
sequence: Validator publishes a higher-sequence manifest with a new ephemeral signing key while retaining the same master key on the UNL.
Long-running proposing nodes may continue to hold recorded votes under the old signing key and fail to match validations signed by the new key.
Old cached vote may remain for approximately 24 hours of ledger close time.
After expiry, affected nodes may remove that validator from both counted votes and the denominator until restart or a UNL membership change.
reported_mechanism.potential_effect: The denominator and vote count may both shrink. A validator whose vote is dropped can delay a majority if it voted yes, or make a majority appear earlier if it voted no. The issue gives 28/35 versus 28/33 as an example.

reported_mainnet_observation.issue_counterevidence: The reporter explicitly states no amendment's pass/fail outcome currently differs.

observations: trustChanged rebuilds recordedVotes_ from the trusted signing-key set.

network_ops.observation: AmendmentTable::trustChanged is still called inside the branch guarded by non-empty TrustChanges.added or TrustChanges.removed.

validator_list.observation: trustedSigningKeys_ is still rebuilt inside the branch guarded by non-empty trustChanges.added or trustChanges.removed.

current_code_recheck.conclusion: The code path described by issue #8534 remains present in current develop at the fetched commit. This corroborates the mechanism but does not independently verify its prevalence or the live vote state of every validator.

relevance_to_xrp_research.affected_research_area: XRPL amendment governance, LendingProtocol/SingleAssetVault activation tracking and validator-vote data quality.
relevance_to_xrp_research.implication: A single explorer or node-specific validations/threshold count must not be treated as a canonical network-wide amendment vote count without recording node version, uptime, UNL/validator list, manifest sequence and ledger index.
relevance_to_xrp_research.relation_to_prior_lending_tracker: Prior secondary counts such as LendingProtocol 21/35, SingleAssetVault 23/35 and LendingProtocolV1_1 21/35 remain observations from their respective trackers. This issue is a reason to qualify them and seek cross-node primary RPC corroboration; it does not prove those specific counts are wrong.
verification_needed: Capture feature and validators RPC outputs from multiple independent mainnet nodes with provider timestamps and ledger indices.
Record each node's rippled version, uptime, trusted validator list, validation quorum and current signing-key manifests.
Compare long-running nodes with recently restarted nodes without restarting or modifying any production validator.
Separate node-local vote/threshold observations from amendment activation state on validated ledgers.

competing_hypotheses_and_limits.hypothesis_a: Signing-key rotation causes stale recorded-vote keys and denominator undercount on affected long-running nodes.
competing_hypotheses_and_limits.hypothesis_b: Observed count differences may also arise from different UNLs, node software versions, stale RPC snapshots or provider display timing.
competing_hypotheses_and_limits.disconfirming_evidence: Issue #8534 itself reports no amendment pass/fail outcome currently differs in its example.
competing_hypotheses_and_limits.independence: The issue report and code recheck come from the same upstream repository; the public explorer count is mentioned by the reporter and is not an independently retrieved raw receipt in this artifact.
not_established: That every XRPL validator is affected.
That the current LendingProtocol 21/35 or SingleAssetVault 23/35 counts are incorrect.
That any amendment activated early or late because of this issue.
That the issue has been accepted or fixed by XRPLF maintainers.

source_receipts.hash_scope: SHA-256 of normalized issue and code-path summary; not raw GitHub HTTP bytes or repository object bytes.
source_receipts.normalized_excerpt:
XRPLF/rippled issue #8534, opened 2026-10-08, remains open and has zero comments as checked 2026-11-08.
The reporter says long-running validators can stop counting a trusted validator's amendment votes after its ephemeral signing key rotates while its master key remains on the UNL. TrustedVotes::recordedVotes_ is keyed by signing key; trustChanged is invoked only when trusted master-key membership changes. The new signing key then misses the recorded-vote map. The old cached vote can remain for about 24 hours of ledger close time, after which the validator may disappear from both the vote count and the denominator until restart or a UNL membership change.
Reported mainnet example on 2026-10-08: validator list had 35 trusted keys and 35 current signing keys, but one node's admin feature reported validations=33, threshold=26 and BatchV1_1 count=28. The reporter says a public explorer showed the same 33/26/28. The issue explicitly says no amendment's pass/fail outcome currently differs.
Current XRPLF/rippled develop branch, commit 192b77d456ef0c14faf6095454b9bbc9476f4ce3, fetched 2026-11-08: AmendmentTable.cpp still keys recordedVotes_ by PublicKey, recordVotes still looks up val->getSignerPublic(), and NetworkOPs.cpp still calls AmendmentTable::trustChanged only when TrustChanges added/removed is non-empty. ValidatorList.cpp still rebuilds trustedSigningKeys_ only in that same membership-change branch.
This code corroborates that the reported mechanism remains present in current develop; it does not independently prove every validator is affected or that a specific LendingProtocol vote count is wrong.
Source: https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/issues/8534
Current source files: https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/misc/detail/AmendmentTable.cpp ; https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/misc/NetworkOPs.cpp ; https://github.com/XRPLF/rippled/blob/develop/src/xrpld/app/misc/detail/ValidatorList.cpp
